title: Power Platform Security Baseline Item
description: YAML front matter schema for ASD Blueprint-style Power Platform and Copilot Studio security baseline items.

id.description: Unique baseline item identifier (PP-TEN-###, PP-ENV-###, or PP-CS-###).

title.description: Short descriptive title of the security setting.

scope.description: Whether the setting applies at the tenant level or per environment.

workload.description: Primary Microsoft Power Platform workload covered by this setting.

severity.description: Security impact severity if the setting is non-compliant.

recommended_value.description: Concise statement of the required or recommended setting value.

rationale.description: Summary of why this setting reduces security risk.

ism_controls.description: Relevant Australian Signals Directorate Information Security Manual (ISM) control identifiers.

essential_eight.description: Applicable Essential Eight mitigation strategies, or an empty list if none apply directly.

configure_summary.description: Brief summary of where and how the setting is configured.

verify_summary.description: Brief summary of how compliance is verified via API or manual inspection.

assessor_check_id.description: Identifier of the corresponding read-only assessor check, or null if manual only.

automated.description: True if the read-only assessor can evaluate this item automatically via a supported API; false for manual verification.

sentinel_rules.description: Optional list of related Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules or hunting queries.

references.description: Official Microsoft Learn, Azure-Sentinel or cyber.gov.au references supporting the item.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the setting and links were last verified.
